recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is for FHIR-3845. If the work group wants to change or document cross-element reuse of the same constraint key, especially reuse with identical expressions, that should be handled as a separate resolved issue.
issue_request: FHIR-3845 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-I change request reporting repeated invariants on profiles and asking whether a profile may define an invariant with the same id as its parent. The decisive Jira comment says that using the same id is an error.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-3845-tagged source commit was found. The active ElementDefinition source already contains eld-14 with human text "Constraints must be unique by key" and FHIRPath "constraint.select(key).isDistinct()". That rule was present when ElementDefinition was split into source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and was later carried forward into the current FHIRPath form.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as an active type with an ElementDefinition type page, so source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml and source/elementdefinition.html are in current build scope. The ElementDefinition guidance says additional constraints can be defined but do not replace constraints from the base definition, while mappings are the separate same-identity replacement case. Later Zulip discussion confirms the current practical rule is not global uniqueness across an IG; inherited duplicate keys can be errors, and any future relaxation for identical expressions is a separate unresolved question.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined branch already carries the active constraint-key uniqueness invariant and related profiling guidance needed for FHIR-3845, and adding more prose would risk overstating the global uniqueness rule or preempting later tooling-policy questions.

related_jiras.note: Later same-source-area mapping issue; it clarifies that mappings, unlike constraints, have same-identity replacement semantics.
